subject: SOC 2 Type II — requested scope, minimal evidence bundle & delivery plan
messages:
From: BrightAudit LLP <auditor@brightaudit.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report + evidence request (Acme scope)

Hi Priya,

We are the external auditors coordinating Acme Digital's due diligence for their vendor risk review. Acme has asked for Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report and supporting artifacts covering the 2025 calendar-year audit period. Please confirm the following so we can finalize our intake: 

1) SOC 2 report: PDF version of the Type II report (confidential).
2) Bridge letter: If your most recent report covers a period that does not fully overlap 2025 (or if there is a gap), a short bridge letter outlining continuity or the next report timing is acceptable.
3) Minimal evidence bundle: a packaged set of artifact samples (policies, change logs, access review printouts, incident response summary, and a configuration snapshot). List the minimal bundle items you can provide.
4) Delivery options: secure SFTP, encrypted Drive link, or an auditor portal—let us know your preferred transfer method.
5) Timeline: Acme would like materials by Oct 8 to complete procurement review. Is that feasible?

Attached: SOC2_Request_Form.pdf (for Acme and your security contact to complete).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Daniel Kim
Senior Manager, BrightAudit LLP
Daniel.Kim@brightaudit.com
+1 415 555 0199

From: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + evidence request (Acme scope)

Thanks Daniel — and thanks Acme team for the heads up. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

Summary answers:
- SOC 2 Type II report: we have a Type II report covering Jan 1, 2025 — Dec 31, 2025. We can provide the confidential PDF.
- Bridge letter: not required for that audit window, but we can include a short attestation (one-page) confirming continuity and no material control changes since the period end if Acme wants it.
- Minimal evidence bundle: see the attached checklist (redwood_minimal_evidence_checklist.xlsx) — it represents a conservative sample set we typically share for procurement due diligence (policies, evidence index, access review extract, recent change-log snippet, production incident summary, and encryption config snapshot). If Acme needs additional telemetry (e.g., token-level logs), we can discuss scoping separately.
- Delivery options: secure SFTP or an encrypted, time-limited Drive share are both supported. We prefer Drive with view/download logging for auditability.
- Timeline: Oct 8 is feasible if we receive final confirmation of which artifacts Acme must see (report only vs report + full bundle).

Logistics/questions for Acme/BrightAudit:
1) Please confirm you want the full minimal bundle or report-only.
2) If you require an NDA or a Docusign for the share, please indicate the signer.
3) Any special redaction requests for the report (we redact internal IP and specific customer references by default).

Next steps we will take once confirmed: Ben will stage the evidence bundle and produce an evidence index; Marissa will manage secure share permissions; I will send a templated reply you can forward internally to request access.

---
Priya Natarajan
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
